people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

translations.web: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
translations.bsb: And when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
